Alex — thanks for the detailed questions. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Metering: embeddings are charged per embedding unit (per 1k vector calls) separately from generative tokens. In v2 I'm separating the lines with illustrative calculations for a typical embedding + gen workload.

2) Term lengths: our published discount bands are offered for both 6- and 12-month committed terms; the deeper discounts (e.g., 20%+) require a 12-month commit or a minimum spend ramp guarantee. I'll call out a 6mo vs 12mo column in v2.

3) Promotional credits: we typically offer limited-time ramp credits for first-quarter usage on committed deals (subject to deal size). For a pilot at 500k tokens we can offer a $10k platform credit applied over the first 30 days; larger credits are linked to multi-month commitments. I'll put a sample credit schedule in v2.

I've updated the packet to v2 and uploaded to the same Drive link. v2 includes: separate embedding line items, 6v12 month columns, sample committed vs PAYG math, and an optional ramp credit table.
